c.title: $4,680 / 2br - 1190ft2 - Prestigious Coal Harbour Waterfront Condo | Fully Furnished 2 Bed 2 Ba (Vancouver)
c.description:
COAL HARBOUR LOCATION:

-Luxury waterfront living at prestigious "Bauhinia" offers a stunning ocean view and is conveniently nestled in between the Coal Harbour Community Centre and the Westin-Bayshore Hotel

-In addition to the building’s close proximity to Stanley Park, residents are able to take advantage of the best in neighbourhood amenities including: Cardero's Restaurant, on-site Café and Bakery Villaggio, the famed Vancouver Seawall, Lift Bar, Cardero Park and many more.

-Burrard SkyTrain is just a ten minute walk away and the Lions Gate Bridge is easily accessible by car


ABOUT THIS UNIT:
- 1,190 SF with an additional outdoor balcony overlooking Coal Harbour & Stanley Park
- Located on 11th Floor, water view, Unit is Fully furnished, updated Kitchen with Miller Kitchen appliances
- In-suite washer/dryer
- Secure storage locker
- Underground parking for 1 car
- Gas fireplace
- No smoking



BUILDING AMENITIES:

- 24-hour Concierge Service
- Marble entrance foyer
- 2 Racquetball courts
- Incredible full-size indoor pool with view!
- Fitness room
- Steam room
- Hot tub
- Library
- Media room
- Outdoor rooftop terrace with BBQ's & children's play area
- Bike storage

Available on 01 Jan 2027, Pets are welcome.
